about: Models the Android app offers to download and run on the phone (LiteRT-LM). The app reads this file each time it opens and keeps the last good copy. To add a model: append an entry (url on huggingface.co, exact sizeBytes and sha256 of the file, the RAM of the phones it suits, whether it reads photos, a note per language). To retire one, set "hidden": true (phones that have it keep it). "minAppVersionCode" hides an entry from app versions too old to run it. Check with: npm test (tests/unit/local-models-catalog.test.ts) and the Android LocalModelCatalogTest.
